verdict.rationale: Asking whether a government tax-filing service publishes its account, credential, and identity-proofing prerequisites up front is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes recording Akamai 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Nothing shows FTB publishing which account, credential, or identity-proofing steps stand between a founder and filing, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
